sales.title: Complete 20 cold calls
sales.description: Reach out to leads from the new prospect list. Focus on understanding their pain points and qualifying them for our solution.

sales.title: Update CRM with call notes
sales.description: Log all interactions from today's calls in the CRM. Include key insights, next steps, and follow-up dates.

sales.title: Send follow-up emails to 10 warm leads
sales.description: Personalized follow-up emails to leads who showed interest. Include case studies and value propositions.

sales.title: Review and update sales pipeline
sales.description: Check all deals in progress, update stages, and identify deals that need attention or are at risk.

outreach.title: Send 50 personalized outreach emails
outreach.description: Target new prospects from the outreach list. Customize each email based on their industry and role.

outreach.title: Engage with 30 posts on LinkedIn
outreach.description: Comment meaningfully on target audience posts. Build relationships and establish thought leadership.

outreach.title: Create content for social media
outreach.description: Draft 3 posts for this week highlighting our value proposition, success stories, or industry insights.

outreach.title: Research 20 new partnership opportunities
outreach.description: Identify potential partners in adjacent markets. Create initial outreach list with contact information.

shitposters.title: Create 5 viral memes for brand
shitposters.description: Generate memes that align with current trends and our brand voice. Focus on relatability and shareability.

shitposters.title: Engage in 10 trending Twitter threads
shitposters.description: Jump into trending conversations with witty, brand-relevant responses. Aim for visibility and engagement.

shitposters.title: Analyze competitor social content
shitposters.description: Review what's working for competitors. Document successful formats, topics, and engagement patterns.

shitposters.title: Test new content format
shitposters.description: Experiment with a new content type (Reels, TikTok, Stories). Create and post 2-3 pieces.
